core.headline: Two-bedroom mid-terrace, Sheerness – guide price £150,000
core.listing:
A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness, offered for sale by Modern Method of Auction with no onward chain. The property requires modernisation throughout and presents an opportunity to create a home to your own specification.

On the ground floor you will find a reception room and a kitchen. The first floor provides two bedrooms and a bathroom. Outside, there is a rear yard.

The property is heated by gas central heating and has mains electricity, mains water (metered) and mains sewerage. Parking is available on-street with no permit required. Broadband is FTTC and there is good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks.

Station Terrace is in Sheerness, a coastal town on the Isle of Sheppey.

Guide Price £150,000. Freehold. For sale by Modern Method of Auction: the buyer pays a non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT, in addition to the purchase price; 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. No onward chain.
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness requiring modernisation, with a rear yard, gas central heating and no onward chain. Guide Price £150,000. Freehold. EPC E.
